summary: Tested 4 new MobileMistri features (pincode auto-detect, Trust Promises strip, Logic Board service, lead status tracking). 25/25 backend pytest tests pass (including 8 new tests for PATCH /admin/{enquiries|bookings}/{id}/status). Frontend: Trust Promises section + 9-service grid + admin status dropdowns all verified end-to-end. Found 1 CRITICAL compile-blocker (CityPage.jsx leftover duplicate JSX) which I fixed so the rest of the app could be tested. Found 1 functional bug: PIN 201301 wrongly resolves to Ghaziabad instead of Noida.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester — file had leftover duplicate JSX block at lines 117-122 (after the closing brace of the component) causing 'SyntaxError: Unexpected token (117:6)'. The whole frontend failed to compile. Removed the dead block.

integration_issues.issue: PIN 201301 detects 'Ghaziabad' but spec & real geography expect 'Noida' (Greater Noida 201301-201318). pincode.js Ghaziabad range [201101,201311] is too wide — should exclude the Greater-Noida sub-ranges. Other 9 pins (110001 Delhi, 700001 unserved, 201005 Ghaziabad, 560001 Bangalore, 500001 Hyderabad, 400001 Mumbai, 411001 Pune, 122001 Gurgaon, 121001 Faridabad) all PASS.

action_items: VERIFY: confirm CityPage.jsx fix is correct (tester removed lines 117-122 — duplicate JSX). The page rendering wasn't deeply re-tested, please open /city/delhi and ensure layout intact.

Fix PIN 201301 mapping: in /app/frontend/src/lib/pincode.js, narrow the Ghaziabad range. Suggested ranges per India Post: Ghaziabad PINs are 201001-201019, 201101-201206 (TS-Hindon), 201207-201210; Greater Noida is 201301-201318. Replace [201101,201311] with [201101,201206] (or split explicitly).
(cosmetic) Address ESLint warnings in AdminDashboard.jsx (missing 'load' dep) and Book.jsx (missing 'data.city' dep).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/CityPage.jsx — had stale duplicate JSX after a recent edit (compile-blocker). Indicates the previous edit was applied with bad search/replace context. Recommend running `yarn build` or eslint as a pre-commit gate.

Logic-Board service in content.py uses icon 'Microchip' but lucide-react has no Microchip icon — Home.jsx and Services.jsx alias `Cpu as Microchip`. Works, but confusing — consider renaming SVC_ICONS key to 'Cpu' or aliasing once in a shared file.

pincode.js: `PREFIX_TO_CITY['201205']='Ghaziabad'` is dead code (never reached: 3-char prefix lookup uses pin.slice(0,3)='201' which always hits 'Noida' before that key). Use only the refine() ranges.
server.py PATCH endpoints don't return updated row, only {id,status}; consider returning the full updated doc (better for frontend to skip refetch).
AdminDashboard StatusCell does optimistic update? Verify it gracefully reverts on PATCH 4xx (couldn't easily test without forcing a failure).

rca_of_the_issue: 1) CityPage.jsx compile-blocker — root cause: previous file edit left an unterminated dangling `))} ); }` block after the actual component close at line 116. Repro: `yarn start` → ERROR in ./src/pages/CityPage.jsx Line 117:6 Unexpected token. Mitigation: removed lines 117-122. 2) PIN 201301 → Ghaziabad — root cause: pincode.js uses range [201101, 201311] for Ghaziabad which incorrectly captures Greater Noida pins (201301+). Mitigation: narrow Ghaziabad upper bound to ~201206 or maintain an explicit Noida-override list for 201301-201318.
